mapper.insert: INSERT INTO status_template (tenant_id, work_type, name, is_default, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workType}, #{name}, #{isDefault}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM status_template WHERE work_type = #{workType} AND is_default = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM status_template WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM status_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND work_type = #{workType} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_default DESC, gmt_create ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE status_template SET name = #{name}, is_default = #{isDefault}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE status_template SET is_deleted = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE status_template SET is_default = 0, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND work_type = #{workType} AND is_default = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
